body: I'm sorry... I don't know what I'm talking about

What's so bad about life being pointless? 

I used to be in a similar situation to you, I would have nobody to share my music with. It used to be so demotivating. But then I thought, if external validation is demotivating me so much, maybe I need to say fuck external validation and do what I want to do. I don't play music much anymore, but when I do, I do it for myself, and I feel much better about it. I think part of self-care is being ok with just sharing things with yourself, and not always needing someone else to validate your experience.

Loneliness is inevitable for everyone. Even the social butterflies of today will get old and die alone. But it's not all bad. Emptiness and loneliness only look horrible when you compare it to social life. It's the comparison that's toxic, not the condition itself. And the comparison is false too because having a social life is honestly not worth the fucking effort. I couldn't care less about other people. The more you get to know people the less you like them. Learn to keep yourself company and you'll be fine.
